name: intelthreadlinqs-mcp
description: MCP server for Threadlinqs Intelligence Platform — 25 tools, 26 prompts and 10 resources across threat intel, detections, IOCs, actors, C2, MITRE chains and correlations

scripts.test:offline: npm run build && npm run test:wire && npm run test:aliases && npm run test:proxy && npm run test:integration && THREADLINQS_SKIP_LIVE=1 npm run test:catalog && npm run test:release-path
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run test:wire && npm run test:aliases && npm run test:proxy && npm run test:integration && npm run test:catalog && npm run check:skill-v9 && npm run test:skill-v9
scripts.build:skills: npm run build:skill && npm run build:skill-v9
scripts.mcpb:build: npm run mcpb:validate && npm run sync:catalog && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=mcpb-build/server/index.mjs && npx --yes @anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2 pack mcpb-build && mv mcpb-build.mcpb intelthreadlinqs-mcp-$npm_package_version.mcpb

author: Threadlinqs Team
